text:
alerts-bot: :warning: anomaly detected: sudden uptick in user-reported quality failures for /v1/generate starting 2026-04-27T14:05:40Z. Metric: user_reject_rate increased from 1.2% -> 18% in 6m.

Ravi (oncall): paging. I'm oncall until 15:00 UTC. Where's the traffic going?

Lena (eng-runtime): looking at routing logs, we see a shift at 14:04:56 where the cost-optimizer policy evaluated and began preferring variant tag cost:low for many routes. Selected variant name shows up as "redwood-gpt-compact-q4".

Priya (sre): traces show a correlated spike in A/B eval failures and an increase in 5xx? No, backend OK. It's not errors but degraded output quality: hallucinations, missing entity completions. Also a pattern where cross-region fallback was disabled due to a config flip (flag: allow_cross_region=false) in the last config deploy. That reduced the high-quality candidate set.

Ravi (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

Lena (eng-runtime): two quick mitigations: 1) disable the cost-optimizer policy (will force default routing), 2) add a temporary denylist for variants with metadata cost:low on customer-facing routes. I can do 1) in ~30s.

deploy-bot: Deploy 7623 to control-plane performed at 14:03:12Z by ci/cd. Changes: toggled feature allow_cross_region -> false in staging->prod rollout step 2.

Carlos (product): we're getting DMs from 3 enterprise customers; one flagged a broken help center fetch which used model completions. Prioritize mitigation and customer comms.

Lena (eng-runtime): executing disable: 
```
POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/routing/policies/cost-optimizer/disable
Auth: service-token
```
Response: 200 - policy disabled at 14:06:11Z.

alerts-bot: policy cost-optimizer disabled by Lena at 14:06:11Z.

Priya (sre): creating runtime override: pin /v1/generate to variants where tag "quality" >= 0.7 in region eu-central-1 and eu-west-1, TTL 1800s. Command: 
```
redwoodctl override create --route "/v1/generate" --selector "env:prod" --condition "variant.quality >= 0.7" --ttl 1800
```
Override created: ov-9876 at 14:06:43Z.

Ravi (oncall): monitoring user_reject_rate and eval harness. Doing quick sanity calls against top customers' prompts.

Lena (eng-runtime): early telemetry: quality signals improved within ~2 minutes of override. User_reject_rate down to 6% by 14:08. However, we still see some requests routed to redwood-gpt-compact-q4 because a small set of routes were labeled internal:true and were exempt from the override. We'll patch that exception.

Priya (sre): looking into cause: I pulled the policy config diff from yesterday's change. The cost-optimizer scoring model was updated as part of a scheduled retrain at 03:00Z; new weights increased cost-sensitivity. Also a recently merged mapping PR (ops/routing#220) inadvertently matched internal route patterns to cost:low allowed list. So two factors: scoring skew + mapping bug.

Carlos (product): we need a concise customer note: what happened, what we mitigated, next steps, and whether we'll issue credits. Triage sends to #customer-comm in 30m.

Lena (eng-runtime): next step: roll the scoring model back to stable version v1.14.4 and add a canary gate to the retrain pipeline that runs the production eval suite. I'll trigger rollback now.

Lena (eng-runtime): rollback command: 
```
kubectl -n routing exec deploy/scoring-service -- curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/admin/load?ver=v1.14.4
```
Response: accepted, loading v1.14.4; active in ~45s.

alerts-bot: scoring-service model set to v1.14.4 by Lena at 14:09:22Z.

Priya (sre): I'm opening a hotfix PR to ensure cross-region fallbacks are not disabled silently by feature flips. Also adding a check: if candidate set after selector filtering < 3, do not apply cost-optimization. PR: github.com/redwood/routing/pull/494.

Ravi (oncall): handover note: I'll keep watching for next 15m then hand to Lena for deeper analysis. Please call me if customers escalate by phone.

Lena (eng-runtime): digging into variant metadata; some variants had cost:low and quality tag missing entirely. The policy assumed missing quality ~0.5 which biased selection. Fix: treat missing quality as unknown and exclude from cost-optimized picks until explicitly scored.

Priya (sre): created alert rule inc-variant-churn if >20% requests switch chosen variant in 5m window. Also created alert for production-eval-regression >5% in 10m.

Carlos (product): confirming customer impact: estimated 14 customers with noticeable degradation, 2 enterprise with SLO risk. We'll prepare apology + mitigation note and propose 10% credit for those 2.

Lena (eng-runtime): long-term actions I'll own:
- Add CI canary step for scoring retrains that runs against production eval set and blocks retrain if quality delta > 2%
- Update policy mapping to explicitly require variant.quality tag presence and minimum value
- Add unit tests for mapping logic to prevent internal-route exception regressions

Priya (sre): ops follow-ups:
- Add runbook step: immediate toggle + override pattern for cost-policy incidents
- Patch fallback code: prefer cross-region higher-quality variants when within latency budget (PR 494)
- Document incident: OV id ov-9876, control-plane change id 7623

Ravi (oncall): metrics stabilized by 14:12:30Z. User_reject_rate trending at 1.8% now. Marking incident as mitigated, will create INC-2026-1749012345 and schedule postmortem tomorrow 08:00 UTC.

alerts-bot: Incident INC-2026-1749012345 created and assigned to Lena. Severity: medium. Status: mitigated.

Lena (eng-runtime): I'll own the post-incident writeup. Saving logs: s3://redwood-incidents/1749012345/logs.tar.gz (routing logs + scoring model evals).

Carlos (product): drafting external comms and will loop in legal for wording.

Priya (sre): adding timeline notes to the incident doc and linking PRs: routing#494, ops/routing#220 (reverted mapping).

Ravi (oncall): handing off active ownership to Lena at 14:15Z. My shift ends 15:00Z.

Lena (eng-runtime): acknowledged handoff. Will run the full postmortem template and include root cause: scoring retrain weight shift + mapping bug + feature flip reduced candidate set.

---
Quick summary bullets:
- Symptom: spike in user_reject_rate for completions due to lower-quality variant selection.
- Immediate mitigation: disabled cost-optimizer policy, created override ov-9876 to pin high-quality variants.
- Root causes: retrained scoring model increased cost weight; mapping bug allowed internal routes to pick cost:low variants; cross-region fallback was disabled by feature flag.
- Short-term fixes: scoring rollback, override, alerting for variant churn.
- Long-term: canary for retrains, require quality tag presence, fallback logic fix, mapping test coverage.

alerts-bot: Incident archived to status: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.
